annotations.title: Confirm the account and get an API key

description: Confirms the registration with the emailed code and the signup_token of sign_up, and returns an API key for this MCP server (shown once). [REST: POST /api/auth/register/verify]

key_days.description: Lifetime of the key in days; null = no limit. Default 365.

key_name.description: Name of the API key in Settings (default «MCP agent»).

lang.description: The account's language: ru, en, es (Spanish), de (German), fr (French), pt (Brazilian Portuguese) or ja (Japanese); the messages, the emails and the texts of its searches. Default en.

name: confirm_sign_up
title: Confirm the account and get an API key
